2026 Kurukuru Hanno Marche

Date and time: Sunday, September 27, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

A market where local producers, restaurants, and creators in Hanno City come together.

Multiple venues will sell food, sweets, and drinks made with local produce:
• Hanno Komachi Park
• In front of Hanno Shinkin Bank Hanno Central Branch
• Arai Sekizai Display Space
• In front of Yaminawa

A diverse lineup of vendors is expected, including a rotating-chef restaurant, a roasting shop, bagel shop, sweets shop, local sake, honey, and more.

This is an opportunity to discover the appeal of Hanno's agricultural products.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2803/
